verdict.rationale: The official Crossplane CLI is documented for testing and rendering Composition Functions locally without a cluster. That is a first-party way to check configuration before applying it, but the evidence never describes schema or config validation as such. No formatting capability is evidenced at all. missing for 10: explicit config validation command (e.g. schema checks of XRs/Compositions), any auto-format/lint capability, depth of docs on pre-apply validation workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
